newsitem.title: USA: Mass. to assume Lawrence's $80 mln budget - paper.
newsitem.headline: Mass. to assume Lawrence's $80 mln budget - paper.

text.p: Massachusetts will assume Lawrence's $80 million budget tab next year, Boston Globe reported Thursday.
Lawrence, under investigation for alleged misspending and going through a state audit, will be the only school system in the state to have its schools paid for by state taxpayers, the paper reported.
The Globe said the state's unprecedented payment is an unintended result of a complex spending formula in the Education Reform Act of 1993, which sent more money to poorer cities.
